name: Rocket Launcher
description: Rocket launchers fire powerful high explosive rockets, but cannot be reloaded once empty. Rockets are vulnerable to bullets while in flight.

logicNodes.label: Trigger
logicNodes.description: When true: fires a loaded rocket.

logicNodes.label: Loaded
logicNodes.description: Returns true when a rocket is loaded and ready to fire.

logicNodes.label: Trigger Passthrough
logicNodes.description: Outputs the trigger value once all rockets have been expended.
